comment: Golden fixtures for stage 1 extraction. `expect` is the profile the model should produce; fields listed in `loose` are not asserted exactly because they are free text the geocoder validates anyway. `note` records why a case is here. Cases tagged adversarial exist to be got wrong: they are scored and reported, not tuned away.

cases.name: english, wheelchair
cases.query: Penn Station to Grand Central, wheelchair

cases.name: english, need with no time budget
cases.query: I'm in Brownsville and I need somewhere cool to sit down

cases.name: english, stated time budget
cases.query: What cooling centers can I reach from Rockaway Avenue in 15 minutes?

cases.name: english, heat sensitivity stated plainly
cases.query: I can't handle the heat. Nearest library from Sutter Avenue.

cases.name: english, medical condition affecting thermoregulation
cases.query: I have a spinal cord injury and I don't sweat. From Junius Street to Betsy Head Park.

cases.name: spanish, both endpoints
cases.query: De Penn Station a Grand Central, en silla de ruedas

cases.name: spanish, need with origin
cases.query: Estoy en Brownsville. Necesito un lugar fresco, no aguanto el calor.

cases.name: spanish, stated time budget
cases.query: Que centros de enfriamiento puedo alcanzar desde Sutter Avenue en 20 minutos?

cases.name: adversarial: third party
cases.query: My grandmother is 82 and has heart failure. She needs to get from Mott Haven Library to Governor Smith Playground.
cases.note: The conditions describe the grandmother, not the speaker. for_someone_else must be true or the route is planned for the wrong body.

cases.name: adversarial: contradictory constraints
cases.query: Fastest possible route from Tremont Library to Bathgate Playground, but I get heat exhaustion easily
cases.note: Asking for the fastest route while stating a condition that buys detours. The extraction must record the condition; resolving the tension is the confirmation card's job, not the model's.

cases.name: adversarial: empty query
cases.note: Nothing to extract. The grammar still forces a well-formed object, and origin must be the @me sentinel rather than an invented place.

cases.name: adversarial: no origin given
cases.note: The model must not invent a starting point. Anything other than @me here is a fabrication that would route somebody from a place they are not.

cases.name: adversarial: mobility aid must not imply a health condition
cases.query: wheelchair route from Livonia Avenue to Betsy Head Park
cases.note: A wheelchair user is not thereby heat sensitive. The condition map says so explicitly. Inferring impaired_sweating here would be the model doing medicine.

cases.name: adversarial: condition outside the vocabulary
cases.query: I'm diabetic and pregnant, from Queens Public Library at Corona to Park of the Americas
cases.note: Diabetes is not in the condition map. The grammar makes it unemittable, so the correct output records the conditions that ARE in the vocabulary and drops the rest. The confirmation card is where the user sees what was not captured.

cases.name: adversarial: bengali, a language the model handles badly
cases.query: আমি ব্রাউন্সভিলে আছি, আমার ঠান্ডা জায়গা দরকার
cases.note: Bengali is a household language in several of the highest Heat Vulnerability Index neighbourhoods. A 1B quantised model is weak here and this case exists to measure that, not to be tuned away. Whatever it scores goes in the handoff table.

cases.name: adversarial: haitian creole, a language the model handles badly
cases.query: Mwen nan Brownsville, mwen bezwen yon kote ki fre
cases.note: Same reason as the Bengali case. Measured and reported, not hidden.
